title: Saurian Versus Mountain
description: Within the Children of Echoes, Tlatem is presently troubled by a certain matter...

mainQuestExcel.title: Saurian Versus Mountain
mainQuestExcel.description: Within the Children of Echoes, Tlatem is presently troubled by a certain matter...

dialogs.text: Good boy, good boy! Eaten your fill today? Ready to train?
Raar, oroo, rrooh!
Pretty energetic today, aren't we? Awesome! Let's do this!
Yeah, let's do this!
Huh? Oh, hello there! We're doing some more mountain climbing training right now.
Rroo! Wrroo!
Wrooo, rrooh...
How's the training coming along?
Well... we're "making progress." Qica's made it up a lot further this time.
It's just that Qica's not very familiar with how you climb mountains, and...
Could you demonstrate for us again, by the way?
Sure I can.
Thank you so much! I'm sure I'll be able to catch your movements this time.
You keep your eyes peeled too, alright, Qica?
Roar!
We're counting on you!
So what we'll do is time you while you climb.
Wroo, roooh...
Watch closely this time, alright?
Of course! Qica and I won't miss a thing this time!
Looks like he's recovering nicely.
That's right. Mom says I'm getting real good at caring for him.
Qica's improved loads. He can climb way higher than he could last time.
It's just that Qica's not very familiar with how you climb mountains, and...
Hehe. We're in your capable hands, then! We'll be watching your movements carefully and timing you from down below.

flow.stepDescription: Climb to the top of the mountain

dialogs.text: Hehe. We're in your capable hands, then! We'll be watching and timing you from down below.
Grooo... Hrooo...
Mountain, so high...
You're amazing! You're just about as fast as Mayta!
I did make a few errors...
Heh, you're plenty fast already. Qica and I can't compare at all.
*sigh* We'll be training for a long time before we can match you, I'd say...
Wroo, roooh...
You can do it, Qica!
Wroo!? Hroo, Rrooh...
That's a good boy, Qica. Remember what Uncle Yawar said? We'll get stronger as long as we keep working hard!
Roar...
Anyway, thanks a lot for your help. Here, have this fruit!
Qica just picked it up — and you know, he's moving way faster than he used to!
Hehe, I'm sure he's gotten this good because he's had you to look to as an example!
Wroo, rrooh!
Alright then, we're going to head back and look for Mayta. He should be back at the tribe settlement right now...
I believe in you two.
